text: FAA guidance states to try reestablishing the control link and, if unavailable, start emergency/contingency procedures for loss of control link and discontinue flight until inspection. Manufacturer manuals indicate RTH behavior varies by condition: Matrice 30T may display a pre-generated RTH path when lighting is good, or enter Original Route RTH when vision is unavailable, and the aircraft may remain in RTH even if RC signal returns; Matrice 4T automates Failsafe RTH on signal loss (triggered by user, low battery, or lost link) and can display an RTH path if vision/lighting permit, with special handling for long RTH distances; Autel EVO Max 4N describes reconnection attempts and automatic action if reconnection fails.
